### 2. Core Operational Logic (The "Tipping Bucket")

To eliminate cumulative error, the system operates on **Integer Phase Locks**.

* **Residual Discarding:** All fractional parts ($\epsilon$) must be expelled as "Heat" and NOT carried to the next cycle.
* **Structural Ratio ($R$):** $R = \delta / \tau$.
* **Fail-Closed:** If $R \ge 1.0$, the system must enter **SILENCE** mode.

```javascript
// The "Truth" from nra_gate_axiom.py & 07_HAN_gate
if (delta >= tau) {
    const residual = delta - tau;
    expel_as_heat(residual); // Confess if this residual is reused
    trigger_integer_jump();
    delta = 0; // Hard reset to zero.
}

```
